common_name: Pantropical Pineapple Fly (Optomotor-blind Chiasma & Transverse Sex Comb)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila ananassae (2.1 µm, detail scale)

governing_model.boundary_conditions: periodic on a rectangular intracellular patch
governing_model.note: Parameters are for the 2.106 µm detail scale. They are not the slot-2841 cellular fit (alpha_scale 1.63, beta_offset 0.412) and not the americana or biarmipes cellular wavelengths.

empirical_claims: Turing (1952) and Schnakenberg (1979): a short-range activator and long-range inhibitor select a finite wavenumber k_c.
Ready, Hanson & Benzer (1976): the Drosophila retina is a neurocrystalline lattice whose repeating unit is a few micrometres, the right tier for a 2.1 µm intracellular mode.
Drosophila 12 Genomes Consortium (2007): D. ananassae is a sequenced sophophoran in the ananassae subgroup, extant (0 Ma).

Gompel et al. (2005): the successor D. biarmipes deploys a male wing spot by cis-regulatory co-option of yellow, a multi-cell pigment field (96 µm in the campaign), not an intracellular granule lattice.
Wittkopp, Carroll & Kopp (2003): abdominal pigment in the virilis-group predecessor lineage (D. americana) is a primordium-scale pattern, coarser than 2.1 µm.

external_datasets.name: Drosophila 12 Genomes Consortium genome set (includes D. ananassae)
